title: Enzo’s CGH Labeling Kit for Oligo Arrays
author: Hendrik F HFvE Van Essen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zjuf4nw

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: In a nuclease‑free thermocycler strip add DNA (X µl), water (19 – X µl) from Vial W, and primers/reaction buffer (20 µl, Vial 1) to a total volume of 39 µl.

steps.title: Mix and spin down
steps.instruction: Cap the strip, flick to mix, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the strip in a cooled 96‑well rack on ice (4 °C) for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Add labeling reagents
steps.instruction: While on ice add 10 µl Cy3 (Vial 2) to the test sample, 10 µl Cy5 (Vial 3) to the reference sample, and 1 µl Klenow Exo‑DNA polymerase (Vial 4) for a total volume of 50 µl.

steps.title: Mix and spin down
steps.instruction: Cap, flick to mix, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add 5 µl Stop Buffer (Vial 5), mix, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Transfer labeled DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the Cy3‑ and Cy5‑labeled DNA to separate 1.5 ml reaction tubes.

steps.title: Add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 275 µl Binding Buffer (Qiagen PB, Catalog #19066) to the purification column.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Load the column, centrifuge 60 seconds at 16,000 g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 650 µl Wash Buffer (PE), centrifuge 60 seconds at 16,000 g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 60 seconds at 16,000 g, discard the collection tube, and place the column in a fresh 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Elute labeled DNA
steps.instruction: Add 10.5 µl Elution Buffer (EB) to the middle of the filter, incubate 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 60 seconds at 16,000 g to elute the labeled DNA.

steps.title: Quantify and store
steps.instruction: Measure yield and dye incorporation with a NanoDrop (MicroArray program). Store the cleaned‑up labeled gDNA at –20 °C in the dark for up to 7 days.
